name: Spiced Raisin Loaf
description: Historical recipe from The Canadian Family Cook Book (1914). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: Flour to make smooth, soft dough
ingredients.originalText: Flour to make smooth, soft dough

ingredients.name: cake of compressed yeast can be used
ingredients.originalText: 1 cake of compressed yeast can be used

instructions.text: Mix warm milk, flour to make a soft dough, a quarter of a cup of old-fashioned yeast; let it stand in a warm place till light.
Then add butter, brown sugar, cinnamon, cloves and allspice, eggs, raisins and bread flour enough to make it smooth and soft.
Dough kneaded well; put in a warm place to rise.
When light mould in a loaf; let rise again.
When it has risen to the top of the pan bake in a moderate oven for one hour.

source.author: Grace E. Denison
source.originalInstructions:
1. Mix warm milk, flour to make a soft dough, a quarter of a cup of old-fashioned yeast; let it stand in a warm place till light.
2. Then add butter, brown sugar, cinnamon, cloves and allspice, eggs, raisins and bread flour enough to make it smooth and soft.
3. Dough kneaded well; put in a warm place to rise.
4. When light mould in a loaf; let rise again.
5. When it has risen to the top of the pan bake in a moderate oven for one hour.
